title: rxdiag harness sanity: sync-vs-raw-async receive-path over TSCH on EMULATED nRF52840-DK

test.description: Node 1 = rxdiag-root (RPL root + TSCH coordinator, sender). Node 2 = rxdiag-leaf (node under test), running BOTH a simple_udp sync listener (logs [SU]) and a raw udp_conn tcpip_event listener (logs [RAW]) that replicates coap-uip's dispatch. On the leaf's trigger, the root sweeps sizes {700..1000} to both leaf ports. This validates the harness logic in the deterministic emulator (expected: both [SU] and [RAW] receive every size, matching the earlier coap-rx-probe result) before running the same leaf firmware on real hardware against the Firefly root.
